text: In the second round of the Delphi Phase, experts considered items 1.1, 1.3, 1.4, 1.5, 1.8, 1.11, 1.12, 2.1, 2.3, 2.4 and 4.2 approved after the review. With all the experts agreeing on the items, we ended the objective content validation step.
